name: Mount Spire Guide

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You've served for many years as a guide who leads expeditions up Mount Spire. As a result, you are inured to high altitudes and know the mountain like the back of your hand.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and the Mountain Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Expertise skill feat with mountain terrain.
